messages:
Maya (Support): FYI customer report — they say when they apply a second promo code it replaces their existing free-trial credit instead of adding on top. Account id 92341, email team@acme.co. Customer expects stacking for trial+promo.

Sam (Support): Can you paste repro steps from the user? also want the UI screenshot if they have one.

Maya (Support): Copied from user: 
1) Sign up, get trial 1000 credits
2) Enter promo code NEWYEAR2026 in Billing -> Promo
3) Promo accepted, shows 500 credits applied
4) Trial credit becomes 0 (they expected 1500)
They attached a screenshot showing only NEWYEAR2026 in the billing UI.

Sam (Support): Thanks. Tried to repro on a fresh account — I can reproduce via the web flow. Looks like applying a promo triggers a backend replace rather than add.

Jordan (Product): This sounds familiar. Our product doc says promo codes are non-stackable unless flagged additive, but trials should be additive. Need to see the logs to know which path executed.

Maya (Support): Attaching server-side billing event snippet from last run: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z INFO billing.apply_promo user=92341 promo=NEWYEAR2026 prev_promo=TRIAL100 credits_before=1000 credits_added=500 credits_after=500
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z DEBUG billing.webhook stripe_event=invoice.updated action=apply_coupon
```

Ravi (Billing): I can see the same entries in logs for that account. The handler call used apply_coupon which uses the coupon_replace path. Looks like the UI is sending the non-additive flag for promo codes.

Jordan (Product): Two possibilities: UI is sending the wrong payload, or the promo metadata in Stripe is mis-tagged (additive=false). Which one is it?

Ravi (Billing): Quick check: Stripe coupons for NEWYEAR2026 have metadata {"stackable":"false"}. But trial coupons use internal credit grants (not Stripe). The bug is at our reconcile endpoint which treats any promo apply as an absolute set of credits when a stripe coupon is present.

Sam (Support): What's the impact window? customer is blocked from using combined credits for their job. They asked for an immediate fix or manual grant.

Jordan (Product): I'll open a hotfix. Ravi, can you confirm the reconcile job behaviour? If true we need a small patch to add credits instead of overwrite when prev_credit_source=="trial".

Ravi (Billing): Confirmed. I can change reconcile logic and ship a small hotfix. ETA ~2 hours for staging, then we'll deploy.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Jordan to staging: rollout/2026-03-15-promo-fix (sha: b7c9f2d).

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded to staging in 4m 12s.

Jordan (Product): Patched reconcile to treat trial grants as additive and not overwrite. Tests added for stacking behavior. Rolling to prod in 30m if no issues.

Maya (Support): I manually granted the customer 1000 credits to restore expected balance and messaged them. They confirmed receipt and are unblocked.

Sam (Support): Will monitor for any other reports, and follow up after prod deploy. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
